prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production 2D cartoon game art for Trashketeers, thick dark outline, soft two-tone cel shading, rust and gold, pink/cyan neon accents. Match the provided reference character EXACTLY; no photorealism, no pixel art, no text, no labels, no borders, no watermark. Flat solid #FF00FF background, no shadows or gradients on background. Create a 2-column by 1-row sheet, 1024x512, equal 512x512 cells, characters contained within cell with generous 32px margins. Waist-up kneeling/compressed defeated posture, readable expressions. Left cell: surrender, both hands raised, sweating pleading grimace, weapon discarded beside him. Right cell: same boss robbed of clothes/equipment, wearing modest opaque boxer shorts, bashfully covering belly/shorts with arms, sack of confiscated loot beside him. Nonsexual comic humiliation, no nudity. Same proportions, facial identity and viewing angle across cells. Beer Baron is the fat brown RAT from reference, not a pig: big round ears, rodent muzzle, buck teeth, round belly with same pink cat graffiti. Left has gold crown, dark sunglasses and wooden beer barrel with GOLD hoops and rivets, foam on top, NO TAP. Gun on ground. Right stripped of armor, crown, glasses and barrel; same rat face and belly graffiti, plain red boxers; crown, glasses, gold hoops at loot sack. User correction: wooden brown staves, gold hoops, rivets, lid edging; removed matching barrel by sack in looted frame.
